import os
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

SRC = "report.pdf"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"
OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

if not os.path.exists(SRC):
    raise SystemExit(f"Input file not found: {SRC}")

# Inspect the original report
reader = PdfReader(SRC)
print(f"Original report pages: {len(reader.pages)}")
meta = reader.metadata
if meta:
    print(f"Original title: {meta.title}")
    print(f"Original author: {meta.author}")

# Build the cover page
width, height = letter
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)

# Title
c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.35)
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.72, "Annual Financial Report")

# Horizontal rule
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.4, 0.4, 0.6)
c.setLineWidth(2)
c.line(width * 0.25, height * 0.68, width * 0.75, height * 0.68)

# Current date
today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Using date: {today}")
c.setFillColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.62, today)

c.showPage()
c.save()
print(f"Cover page written: {COVER}")

# Merge cover + report
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print(f"Merged output written: {OUT} with {len(writer.pages)} pages")

# Validate the output
check = PdfReader(OUT)
print(f"Validation - output page count: {len(check.pages)}")
first_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
print("Validation - cover page text:")
print(first_text)

import os
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

SRC = "report.pdf"
COVER = "cover_page.pdf"
OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"


def build_cover_pdf(path):
    """Write a minimal one-page PDF cover (letter size) with title and date."""
    title = b"Annual Financial Report"
    date_str = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y").encode("ascii")

    def center_x(text_bytes, font_size, avg):
        return (612 - len(text_bytes) * font_size * avg) / 2

    title_x = center_x(title, 30, 0.55)
    date_x = center_x(date_str, 16, 0.5)

    content_parts = [
        b"BT\n/F1 30 Tf\n0.10 0.10 0.35 rg\n",
        f"{title_x:.2f} 570 Td\n".encode("ascii"),
        b"(" + title + b") Tj\nET\n",
        b"0.40 0.40 0.60 RG 2 w\n153 535 m 459 535 l S\n",
        b"BT\n/F2 16 Tf\n0.20 0.20 0.20 rg\n",
        f"{date_x:.2f} 490 Td\n".encode("ascii"),
        b"(" + date_str + b") Tj\nET\n",
    ]
    content = b"".join(content_parts)

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        (b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode("ascii") + b" >>\nstream\n"
         + content + b"\nendstream"),
    ]

    pdf = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(pdf))
        pdf += str(i).encode("ascii") + b" 0 obj\n" + obj + b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(pdf)
    pdf += b"xref\n0 " + str(len(objects) + 1).encode("ascii") + b"\n"
    pdf += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        pdf += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii")
    pdf += (b"trailer\n<< /Size " + str(len(objects) + 1).encode("ascii")
            + b" /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n"
            + str(xref_pos).encode("ascii") + b"\n%%EOF\n")

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(pdf)


if not os.path.exists(SRC):
    raise SystemExit(f"Input file not found: {SRC}")

# Inspect the original report
reader = PdfReader(SRC)
print(f"Original report pages: {len(reader.pages)}")
meta = reader.metadata
if meta:
    print(f"Original title: {meta.title}")
    print(f"Original author: {meta.author}")

# Build the cover page
today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Using date: {today}")
build_cover_pdf(COVER)

cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
print(f"Cover page parsed OK, pages: {len(cover_reader.pages)}")

# Merge cover + report
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print(f"Merged output written: {OUT} with {len(writer.pages)} pages")

# Validate the output
check = PdfReader(OUT)
print(f"Validation - output page count: {len(check.pages)}")
first_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
print("Validation - cover page text:")
print(first_text)

from pypdf import PdfReader

OUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
reader = PdfReader(OUT)
print(f"Total pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages, start=1):
    text = (page.extract_text() or "").strip()
    print(f"--- Page {i} (first 300 chars) ---")
    print(text[:300])
    print()

def build_cover_pdf(path):
    """Write a minimal one-page PDF cover (letter size) with title and date."""
    title = b"Annual Financial Report"
    date_str = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y").encode("ascii")

    def center_x(text_bytes, font_size, avg):
        return (612 - len(text_bytes) * font_size * avg) / 2

    title_x = center_x(title, 30, 0.55)
    date_x = center_x(date_str, 16, 0.5)

    content_parts = [
        b"BT\n/F1 30 Tf\n0.10 0.10 0.35 rg\n",
        f"{title_x:.2f} 570 Td\n".encode("ascii"),
        b"(" + title + b") Tj\nET\n",
        b"0.40 0.40 0.60 RG 2 w\n153 535 m 459 535 l S\n",
        b"BT\n/F2 16 Tf\n0.20 0.20 0.20 rg\n",
        f"{date_x:.2f} 490 Td\n".encode("ascii"),
        b"(" + date_str + b") Tj\nET\n",
    ]
    content = b"".join(content_parts)

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        (b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode("ascii") + b" >>\nstream\n"
         + content + b"\nendstream"),
    ]

    pdf = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(pdf))
        pdf += str(i).encode("ascii") + b" 0 obj\n" + obj + b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(pdf)
    pdf += b"xref\n0 " + str(len(objects) + 1).encode("ascii") + b"\n"
    pdf += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        pdf += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii")
    pdf += (b"trailer\n<< /Size " + str(len(objects) + 1).encode("ascii")
            + b" /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n"
            + str(xref_pos).encode("ascii") + b"\n%%EOF\n")

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(pdf)
